transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: ConversalQ support, how can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Your app has been really slow for the past two days. Messages take like 8 to 10 seconds to get a response. It used to be under 2 seconds.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I apologize for the degraded experience. Can you tell me which region you're in, and are you using the web app or the API directly?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: We're in the EU — Frankfurt. Using the API directly in our production app.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you. I can see we had a capacity scaling event in the EU-West region starting May 4th. Our engineering team is aware and actively working on it. Current estimated resolution is within 4 hours.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: This is affecting our customers. Is there a status page I can monitor?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Yes — status.conversalq.com shows real-time updates for all regions. The current incident is listed there with updates every 30 minutes. I'd also recommend subscribing to email alerts on that page.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: OK. Is there any workaround in the meantime?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You can temporarily route requests to our US-East endpoint at api-us-east.conversalq.com. Latency will be slightly higher from Frankfurt, around 150ms overhead, but it's currently performing normally.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: That's actually helpful. I'll do that. Thanks for the transparency.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Of course. We'll send a post-incident report to all affected accounts within 48 hours of resolution. Is there anything else I can help with?
